messages.subject: [StatET - Sweave] How to change the path of output file?
messages.subject_clean: [StatET - Sweave] How to change the path of output file?
messages.body_plain:
Dear Users,
By default configuration in sweave-pdf profile , my pdf gets generated in the workspace directory. However i wish to generate it in a different location.
I tried to edit the profile like below:
Under this location,
Sweave-PDF -> LaTex -> Output directory 
I tried to add my output directory path, However i get the below error: 
"The output directory could not be resolved for Tex builder/viewer. The Sweave processing is aborted".
Kindly help me to solve this problem.
Thank you.
yours sincerely,
Chris

messages.body_plain:
Dear Users,


As of now i am working with a single Rnw file and everything works great.


Now the LOC has increased and hence the complexity of reading the file has increased. Hence i like to compile multiple Rnw files and output a single LaTex document.


I am really sorry to ask this basic question, as i could not find any answers related to StatET in my search.


Further,  i understand that we can write a make file to do this. If i do with StatET do i need to write  a make file?
https://csgillespie.wordpress.com/2011/05/12/makefiles-and-sweave/


Any link, or step by procedures to do this would be really helpful.


Thank you.
yours sincerely,
Chris

messages.subject: [StatET - Sweave] Hmisc Package & pdflatex
messages.body_plain:
Dear Users,


Once again i am really sorry to take up a old issue related to Hmisc package usage. 
https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-help//2013-April/352123.html


*.dvi file is created in the working directory, however MiKTeX searches for it in a temporary folder.


I have the below code, that prints the summary of some data. I tried out the solution provided by Duncan in the above post. However that did not solve the problem.


Error: Windows API error 2: The system cannot find the file specified
C:\Users\admin\AppData\Local\Temp\Rtmpam6Z3f\file40085f2f11f8.dvi


Any more ideas on how to point MiKTeX to the working directory for the dvi file?


\documentclass{report}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}\usepackage{siunitx,booktabs}\sisetup{group-separator={,},group-minimum-digits={3},  output-decimal-marker={.}}\usepackage[noae]{Sweave}\begin{document}
<<>>=library("Hmisc")Evaluation <- "D://SVN_Data/Christober/Raw_Data/Cell_Design_Simulation/Evaluation_Result.csv"Input_Evaluation <- read.csv(Evaluation,header=TRUE,na.strings=c("","NA"))@<<echo=false,results=tex>>=latex(describe(Input_Evaluation))@
\end{document}


Thank you.
Yours sincerely,
Chris
